abstract: Adds Swift Package Manager support to existing Capacitor plugins: CLI-derived package/product naming, root Package.swift, CAPBridgedPlugin conversion, ObjC bridge removal, Sources/Tests layout, podspec and package.json updates, third-party, resource and binary dependencies, Capacitor 9 optional Cordova product, verification commands and real error strings.
triggers: add spm support to capacitor plugin
plugin is not implemented on ios spm
